rv.q: It’s a performance that will haunt me for some time, I suspect.
Girls & Boys makes the most of this uneasiness, disarming the audience while getting us to face some of our ugliest truths.
After the first third, Girls & Boys becomes the best show I’ve seen this season.
Marker definitely makes a connection with the audience through her super-convincing acting as Woman.

cn.t: Cynthia Marker delivers a powerful, devastating performance in this one-woman show that walks a tightrope between dry comedy and deep tragedy, though it takes time to find its footing before reaching its gut-wrenching emotional impact.
